title: Portuguese-Style Braised Cabbage with Kicked-Up Kissed Flair
description: A hearty, comforting side dish that combines the flavors of Portugal with the sweetness of kissed cabbage. Perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: Portuguese salad
ingredients.notes: use a mix of lettuce, onion, and olives

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: mince finely to avoid overpowering the dish

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: use kosher salt for best flavor

instructions: 1. Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
2. Add garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
3. Add sliced cabbage and cook for 5-7 minutes, until slightly tender.
4. Stir in chopped salad, salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes (if using).
5. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until cabbage is tender and salad is wilted.
6. Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or chives (optional).
